html: Coastal Metrics develops machine monitoring software for plastics manufacturers.
Coastal Metrics is headquartered in Lyon, France.
Meet us at the SPS trade fair in Nuremberg, Germany, in November.

label_rationale: Software for manufacturers (industry and target business met), headquartered in Lyon, France. The trade fair in Nuremberg is an event, not a company location. Any confirmed own site in DACH would meet the geography criterion, and the text neither shows one nor confirms that there is none, so geography is unknown.
